attr.title: Super Mario Sunshine
attr.desc: Native Linux ARM64 decompilation port of Super Mario Sunshine (based on chasem-dev/sms-pc-port with OpenGL ES 3.1+ backend). Tuned for 480x320 handhelds and 1 GB RAM devices such as the Anbernic RG351P running ArkOS.
attr.inst: Place your legally dumped North American (GMSE01 Rev 0) Super Mario Sunshine disc image (.iso, .gcm, or .ciso) inside ports/sms/gamedata/ before launching.
